$comment: P69 (lane lm, the library-datum ALIAS key): glibc exports ONE environment object under three names, and DSS's <unistd.h> now says so with ONE row and its measured `aliases` ({"elf": ["__environ", "_environ"]}) instead of two unrelated rows. Every name must reach the same object: the program compares environ, __environ and _environ. ✔MEASURED, the same stdout and exit 42 from gcc 13.3.0 (-std=c2x and the GNU default), clang 18.1.3 and aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc (probe-reference-cc run 20261001-003100-d1e55e79). glibc's <unistd.h> declares __environ always and environ only under _GNU_SOURCE, never _environ, so the program declares environ and _environ itself (C 7.1.4) — compatible redeclarations of DSS's rows. ELF only: libSystem exports `environ` alone (measured), so the alias set — and this program — is glibc's.
